name: פָּארָן
summary: Paran gives its name to the wilderness where Ishmael lived, and occurs in El-paran, a landmark beside the wilderness. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: The advance reaches El-paran, which the verse locates beside the wilderness.
Ishmael lives in the wilderness of Paran.

note: Moved from the former word entry `ppaa2raan` (old root key פארנ).
